blocks.text: Polygenic characters are controlled by many gene pairs, not just one. In polygenic inheritance, all alleles of many genes contribute to the same trait in an additive way (some increase, some decrease the effect). The combined effect produces a single trait.

Polygenic traits show a range of differences i.e., continuous variation in a population. Examples of polygenic traits include height, skin colour, weight, intelligence in humans, and grain colour in plants.
